setup: A course is described as [[theta]] degrees from the nearest north-south axis, and you are asked for its bearing, measured clockwise from north.

steps.say: The described course lies in quadrant [[quadrant]] of the compass, counting from the north-east quadrant as zero. The quadrant decides which of the four conversions applies.
Measuring clockwise from north places the course at a bearing of [[answer]] degrees, which lies between 0 and 360.
